dialogueFollowup.change: Opening terms now confront the incentive for future towns to surrender with the town's desire for accountability. Public-safety response distinguishes protection of life from innocence, while the veteran refuses to promise every soldier's compliance.

source.rightsBoundary: Reference metadata and original paraphrase only. No private book file, modern translation or edition annotation redistributed.
source.receivedAccount: The account places Wu Chen's advance north of the river. Kuai Che argues that killing surrendering Qin officials encourages other towns to resist. Public honors and protection for the Fan Yang official are followed in the account by further surrenders.
source.uncertainty: This is a later compiled historical account, not proof that a particular guarantee always produces surrender. The reported scale is not a numerical gameplay rule.

sceneDesign.viewpoint: A reconstructed northern envoy's mandate linked to the player's Chen council, not Chen Sheng or his whole army instantly arriving at Fan Yang.
sceneDesign.dramaticQuestion: Can you promise safety to an enemy official and still command the soldiers who must enforce it?
sceneDesign.opening: Outside the closed gate, the official's messenger asks who will stop the rebel soldiers from killing him after he surrenders. A veteran asks who gave the envoy permission to protect a Qin officer.
beats: Inspect the official's proposed surrender and hear the veteran's objection before choosing terms.

Offer immediate public protection, demand a witnessed transfer with safeguards, or decline the bargain and sustain military pressure. Each route must expose its time, supply and coalition costs before confirmation.
Face an implementation challenge from your own side. Earlier authority and dispatch promises constrain what the envoy can credibly order; a choice of words alone cannot guarantee compliance.
Resolve the gate's response and the coalition's reaction separately. A closed gate must permit withdrawal or a costly revised negotiation instead of an unexplained game-over.
sceneDesign.strategicLens: Credible commitment and signaling: safety has value only if the recipient expects it to survive surrender. Public protection can reassure other towns while angering allies. Conditional safeguards reduce exposure but consume time and may look like a trap.
sceneDesign.counterfactualBoundary: Dialogue, veteran objections, envoy viewpoint, alternatives, costs and outcomes are original dramatization. The historical surrender is one reference outcome, not the mandatory winning answer.
sceneDesign.continuity: Use an explicit time/location transition. Preserve the Chen ledger and dispatch decision. Do not reuse rain, costume, travel distance or character identity as established historical fact without scene review.

Core tests exhaust every legal continuation of all 77 Chen council routes, including empty-granary withdrawal.
implemented.clientCheckpoint: Web/Android-shared React source now exposes an explicit continuation after the Chen conclusion. Separate durable-first save, replayed reactions, exact forecasts, failed-save rollback/retry and confirmed scene reset are implemented. Eight UI tests cover a full surrender route through Chen, withdrawal, remount, deferred durability, failed save, incompatible-save preservation and accessibility semantics in English, Simplified Chinese and English fallback for Arabic. This is DOM-level evidence, not packaged Android, native iOS, Unreal or visible browser qualification.
implemented.fullShellCheckpoint: Two App-level routes start at the title and play all four Chapter I orders, three Chen orders and three Fan Yang orders through visible DOM controls. Both verify controller inspection without committing, modal focus wrapping, shortcut isolation, parent backdrop/Escape/native-Back locks during a pending write, mid-scene application remount, exact earlier-save preservation and the opened outcome. One injects a failed durable write before retry. A read-only decision journal now exposes each saved reaction, conditional promise response and exact before/after metrics. Full npm run validate passes 44 core and 127 web tests; graphical browser and physical-device evidence remain outstanding.
